notes.subject: התפאר עלי
notes.rationale: lit. 'make yourself glorious over me'; JPS reads 'have thou this glory over me', i.e. Moses yields to Pharaoh the honor of setting the time — rendered 'mekim nem bilong yu long mi'.

notes.subject: אעתיר
notes.rationale: root means 'burn incense', here 'intercede/pray' — rendered 'askim strong'.

notes.subject: to Pharaoh
notes.rationale: Moses directly addresses Pharaoh with a question inviting him to choose the time.

translation: Na Mose i tok long Paroh: Mekim nem bilong yu long mi — long wanem taim bai mi askim strong long yu, na long ol wokman bilong yu, na long ol manmeri bilong yu, bilong rausim ol frok long yu na long ol haus bilong yu? Tasol long wara ol bai stap.

tokens.gloss: na long ol wokman bilong yu
na long ol manmeri bilong yu
na long ol haus bilong yu
